cards.title: Democrats Launch Nvidia Investigation Over China Dealings
cards.body: Congressional Democrats have launched a second investigation into Nvidia's China sales and alleged connections to Trump. The probe follows reports of potential national security concerns.

cards.title: Muse AI Now Places Calls to US Businesses
cards.body: Muse's AI assistant can now make outbound calls to U.S. businesses for a fee. The paid service marks an expansion of the platform's capabilities.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Affair Scandal
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned following reports of an affair with potential national security implications. The scandal could impact the U.S.-China AI infrastructure race.

cards.title: Nebius Plans $40 Billion AI Infrastructure Expansion
cards.body: Nebius is funding its massive AI infrastructure buildout through customer prepayments and loans. The strategy faces scrutiny amid delays at a Microsoft data center.

cards.title: Huang Linked to Third Alleged Affair: Reuters
cards.body: Reuters reports Jensen Huang was having a third affair with an Nvidia employee. The outlet is withholding the employee's name.

cards.title: Google Search Upgrades with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
cards.body: Google's new AI Mode powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen better understands complex queries and delivers richer visual responses. The upgrade aims to surface more relevant search results.

cards.title: Nectar Launches AI Agent for Influencer Marketing
cards.body: Nectar's new AI agent automates creator discovery, outreach, and partnership management for brands. The tool also tracks campaign performance and results.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Threatens Nvidia's Open Source Commitment
cards.body: Jensen Huang's resignation raises questions about Nvidia's dedication to open-source AI initiatives. The uncertainty extends to its Hugging Face acquisition and open-weight models.

cards.title: Hugging Face CEO Vows Continued Open Source Fight
cards.body: Hugging Face CEO pledged ongoing support for open-source AI after Huang's departure. The commitment raises questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition.

cards.title: United Airlines Blocks AI Agents from Bookings
cards.body: United Airlines has prohibited customers from using AI agents to book flights and manage reservations. The airline cited cybersecurity risks as the primary concern.

cards.title: SoftBank's $3B Loss Dampens AI Energy Ambitions
cards.body: SoftBank lost over $3 billion on preordered natural gas turbines for AI data centers. The loss signals potential challenges for AI's power infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: Phota Labs Uses AI for Photo Enhancement
cards.body: Phota Labs is automating photo editing with AI to help consumers create professional-quality images. The tool simplifies the editing process for everyday photography.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Agrees to Testify Before Congress
cards.body: Ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before Congress after lawmakers threatened subpoenas. The hearing follows reports of alleged espionage-linked affair.

cards.title: Huang's Ouster Could Damage AI Industry Progress
cards.body: Jensen Huang's downfall extends beyond scandal to threaten specific AI industry initiatives he championed. His departure may reshape the sector's strategic direction.

cards.title: Trump Suggests Tim Cook for Nvidia CEO
cards.body: President Trump posted on Truth Social that Apple chairman Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia. The suggestion comes amid the CEO leadership vacuum.

cards.title: Nvidia CFO Kress Named Interim CEO Replacement
cards.body: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is stepping in as interim replacement for ousted CEO Jensen Huang. The leadership transition occurs amid the ongoing scandal.

cards.title: Norwest Launches $4 Billion AI Investment Fund
cards.body: Norwest Venture Partners has raised a $4 billion fund for AI investments, its largest to date. The fund marks the firm's deeper commitment to the sector.

cards.title: Fireworks AI Suffers Second Data Breach in Months
cards.body: A cyberattack on Fireworks AI exposed Notion customers' chat transcripts. This marks the second breach for the startup in as many months.

cards.title: Nine Korean Startups Enter Disrupt 2027 Competition
cards.body: Nine Korean deep-tech startups are competing for Disrupt 2027's Startup Battlefield 200. The ventures span healthcare, fintech, energy, semiconductors, and AI sectors.

cards.title: Who Could Replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia?
cards.body: With no succession plan in place, Nvidia faces urgent leadership decisions after Huang's resignation. Potential successors remain under speculation amid the company's crisis.

cards.title: Nancy Pelosi's Replacement Ready to Regulate AI
cards.body: California congressman Scott Wiener, who authored state legislation on advanced AI risks, won Nancy Pelosi's San Francisco seat. He's now positioned to influence federal AI policy as a key congressional voice on AI regulation.

cards.title: FAA Expands AI to Manage US Air Traffic
cards.body: The FAA is rolling out AI systems to manage air traffic congestion across the entire US airspace. The expansion aims to improve efficiency and safety in one of the world's busiest aviation networks.

cards.title: Google Rolls Out Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model
cards.body: Google has released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing the Gemini 3.8 Flash model. The new version represents a significant update to Google's AI capabilities.

cards.title: Google Faces AI Moratorium Calls in Schools
cards.body: Schools are calling for AI moratoriums following backlash over Google's Gemini pilot program. The move raises concerns about deploying unproven AI tools in educational settings.

cards.title: Google Debuts Gemini-Powered Smartglasses at $395
cards.body: Google is launching AI-powered smartglasses featuring Gemini, starting at $395. The company is emphasizing privacy features as a key differentiator.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned from his position. The departure marks a significant leadership change for the AI chip giant.

cards.title: TSMC Invests $1B in Anthropic and OpenAI
cards.body: Taiwan's TSMC is investing $1 billion in both Anthropic and OpenAI. The move strengthens ties between the chip manufacturer and leading AI companies.

cards.title: AI in Specialty Chemicals Industry Innovation
cards.body: Companies are leveraging AI and cloud computing to accelerate innovation in specialty chemicals. The key challenge is connecting new technologies with reliable data and practical market realities.
